statement: For p > 8 there is a triangulated equivalence F : hSpE −→ D(M) whose sheaf homology is naturally identified, under descent and the periodic regrading below, with the E∗E-comodule homology functor E∗(−). Its suspension structure gives natural isomorphisms F(Σj Z) ∼ = (FZ)[j] (j ∈ Z).
